name: Midrange all-flash, RAID 6 (8+2)
description: Synthetic vendor-neutral midrange all-flash array with RAID 6 (8 data + 2 parity): 4 RAID groups, 42 populated drives, 2 global spares in a fictional 48-slot enclosure. Educational demonstration profile; not a real array. See docs/environment-profile-proposal.md.
provenance: synthetic educational assumption; see docs/synthetic-profile-proposal.md and docs/environment-profile-proposal.md
assumptions: write-back cache with no write coalescing; every logical write destages as one modeled backend block
no rebuild or degraded-state activity is modeled
single declared read-cache hit fraction of 0.30 is a simplification applied to all logical reads
usable capacity is declared after 5% metadata/reserve; spares and parity are excluded
the two variants are distinct drive populations (47 vs 42 drives) with equal declared performance limits; this is a comparison device, not identical hardware
the environment block is descriptive only; no environment field participates in any rule

baselineLatency.basis: documentation only; M2 derives weekly latency statistics from the trace

environment.architecture: vendor-neutral midrange all-flash block array, dual controller, active-active, 48-slot NVMe enclosure (fictional; slot count is a declared assumption)
environment.hostPorts: 8 x 32 Gb/s FC (4 per controller), hosts dual-pathed
environment.note: Performance limits are declared synthetic sustained figures; not derived from drive count or port line rate.
